Haji Ali Juice Centre is one of those places in Mumbai that almost everyone has heard about, and naturally, expectations are quite high before visiting. On top of that, the pricing feels a bit on the higher side for what is offered. While the quality is decent, it doesn’t quite justify the cost, making it seem overrated.
